{AOW_HERO} has studied the Art of War and is going to besiege {AOW_GARRISON_1} instead of {AOW_GARRISON_2}.
Art Of War
Garrison Hours

When an army leader captures a fief, the amount of troops required from army members to garrison the fief for the set time. The script loops through all parties and will choose as many parties until the troop requirement is met. The army leader will not be selected to garrison the fief.
Require Healthy
Only consider healthy troops from army members when selecting parties to garrison.
Siege Target

When an army is off to besiege an enemy, the script will try to figure out if it has to go past another closer enemy garrison and if so to switch to that one. An army can not just bypass garrisons to capture whatever settlement they want.
Display messages from the mod.
Display messages from the mod for all kingdom clans. When disabled it will be player clan only.
Player Army
The amount of time you want a NPC party to garrison a settlement after it has been captured.
Apply automatic garrison behavior when a settlement is captured to the player led army. Some parties will need to disband from the army to do this.
Chase Fix
Prevent army from chasing faster parties and keep them on objective.
Patrol Logic
When an army decides to patrol a friendly settlement, the mod ensures it is near the front lines or it chooses a target closer to an enemy settlement.
Patrol Logic Range

Range used to look for the front lines from the friendly settlement patrol target, to determine if it is a valid patrol target. If an enemy settlement is not within this range, then the mod will choose the last attacked friendly settlement, if one exists or else it allows the army to proceed with whatever it was doing.
Sally Out
Enable sallying out of garrison parties to help allies under attack.
Sally Out Range
The range garrison parties should use when deciding to help defending ally parties outside the settlement. They will sally out only if they think the battle is winnable with their help.
Garrisons will sally out to help allies under attack based on the strength of the enemy. Higher values will make the garrison more cautious when deciding to leave or stay.
